name: Entity Fallback Value
description: adds a fallback system to resolve a content-entity value from a prioritized list of fields (first non-empty wins), exposed via a service, a Twig function and tokens.

suggests.token: Enables the [<entity>:efv_<key>] token integration implemented in src/Hook/Token.php (the token hook autowires the 'token' service).

project_description: Entity Fallback Value gives developers a cascade/fallback system for reading content-entity values from a prioritized list of fields: the first non-empty field (or nested field path across entity references) in the chain wins. Chains can be passed ad hoc to the service, or declared per entity-type/bundle in an EntityFallbackValue plugin (scaffolded with `drush generate plugin:entity_fallback_value`). Resolved values are reachable from PHP via the entity_fallback_value.manager service, from Twig via the getEntityFallbackValues() function, and from tokens as [<entity>:efv_<key>]. The typical use is showing an optional override field when it is set and otherwise falling back to a default field, without writing bespoke logic at each call site.
